    while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') { x = x * 10 + (c - '0'); c = getchar(); }
    return x * f;
}

inline void addMod(int &x, int y) {
    x = (x + y) % MOD;
}

struct Matrix {
    int a[MAXN][MAXN];
    int n;
    
    Matrix(int size = 0) : n(size) { clear(); }
    
    void clear() {
        memset(a, 0, sizeof(a));
    }
    
    void setIdentity() {

    }

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        A[i] = E;
        for (int j = 1; j <= n + 1; ++j) {
            A[i].a[j][i] = 1;
        }
    }
    
    vector<Matrix> pre(n + 2, Matrix(n + 1)), suf(n + 2, Matrix(n + 1));
    pre[0].setIdentity();
    suf[n + 1].setIdentity();
    
    for (; m > 0; m /= n) {

                s = (s + v / n) % n;

            u = (s + u - 1) % n + 1;

                if (u <= 0) u += n;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
